declarations.docstring: Free objects are projective after applying the displayed binary module construction.
Constructs a retract between the results of the displayed binary module construction.
The displayed iterated module construction preserves projective objects.
Linear equivalence from a free module carrier to finitely supported coefficient functions.
The left free-module equivalence acts as the identity on carrier elements.
Evaluation after the left free-module equivalence commutes with scalar multiplication.
Linear equivalence from the second free module carrier to finitely supported coefficient functions.
The right free-module equivalence acts as the identity on carrier elements.
Evaluation after the right free-module equivalence commutes with scalar multiplication.
Linear equivalence from a tensor product of free module carriers to functions on pairs with finite support.
The free tensor equivalence carries scalar multiples of pure tensors to the corresponding product scalar action.
At a pair of indices, the free tensor equivalence of a pure tensor is the tensor of the evaluated coefficients.
A linear equivalence over the tensor product algebra from free module tensors to finitely supported functions on pairs.
